final_message:
**Status: verified** on `local-full` at full precision; every check beats its null controls.

## The function

The model splits the five symbols into two classes, `{lo, vo}` and `{do, po, to}`. It outputs how many of the 6 input tokens (the last one included) are in the same class as the last token.

```python
def predict(tokens, prompt):
    A = {3, 6}                      # lo, vo ; the other class is do, po, to (2, 4, 5)
    seq = tokens[1:7]
    last_in_A = seq[-1] in A
    return 7 + sum((t in A) == last_in_A for t in seq)   # digit ids start at 7
```

## The circuit: `mlp0` → head `1.1` → `mlp1`

- **`mlp0`** works at each of the six token positions and not at BOS (patching one position restores 0.29–0.36, BOS 0.0; E0012). That it writes a class mark is inferred, not read out directly.
- **Head `1.1`** at the last position attends equally to BOS and to every same-class token. When the last token is alone in its class, it puts 0.5 on BOS, 0.5 on itself and 0 elsewhere (E0009).
- **`mlp1`** works only at the last position (patching it there alone restores 1.0; E0012). That it decodes the attention fraction into the digit is inferred.
- **Not involved:** heads `0.0`, `0.1` and `1.0`. Mean-ablating all three together leaves the metric at 1.0 (E0006).

Resample-ablating `1.1`, `mlp0` or `mlp1` individually drops the metric to 0.0 (E0007, E0008).

## Verification (V0001, held-out seed 7, n=200)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `predict()` agreement with the model | 1.0 (200/200) |
| Circuit ablated | 0.0015 of clean, accuracy 0.25 |
| Everything else ablated | 1.0 of clean, accuracy 1.0 |
| Random same-size ablation sets | 1.0, 1.0, 1.0 |

## Record

- **Predictions:** 7 pre-registered, 7 confirmed, 0 refuted.
- **Budget:** 13 of 25 experiments used (5 of them exploratory), plus one verification.

## Gaps

- The `mlp0` → `1.1` edge is not separately measured: path patching errored with an MLP as sender.
- Only the count = 1 case of the attention rule was pre-registered; the general 1/(1+count) weighting rests on an exploratory mean pattern (E0005).
- With only 6 components, the random-ablation control is coarse.
